s1.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: an igloo room with pale ice-brick walls

s3.desc: a dining nook with a round table and wooden chairs, drawn on a plain pale grey background

beats.text: Pax and Polly stand facing each other, Pax with his flippers tucked behind his back
Pax pulls a bouquet of orange flowers from behind his back and holds it out to Polly
Pax holds the bouquet out while Polly gazes at it and lifts a flipper toward it

spans.notes: plain flat background, motion cannot fit; judged by eye and a foreground-bbox track: both ground shadows stay on y 320/480 and overlap in compare 0/27, character heights constant, f0-7 identical frames. No overlay in top third or bottom fifth

beats.text: Polly stares wide-eyed at a bouquet of orange flowers held out to her from the right
Polly takes the bouquet from the flipper holding it out and pulls it in
Polly hugs the bouquet to her chest and closes her eyes with a happy smile
Polly cuddles the bouquet with her eyes closed as a red heart pops up beside her head

spans.notes: plain flat background; Polly's ground shadow overlaps exactly in compare 28/66 and her outline is frame-identical f28-33, f43-50, f60-66: camera locked. Only Pax's flipper shows, at the right edge f28-41 (he is not listed: never more than a flipper). Polly's whole body is ~60% of the height: medium, close to medium close-up. No overlay in top third or bottom fifth

spans.view: with a vase of orange flowers on a small round table in front of a round window looking out on a snowy hill with a tree

beats.text: Polly walks in from the right and stops beside the vase of flowers
Polly stands beside the table and gazes at the flowers
Polly shuts her eyes and leans in, resting her flippers on the table to smell the flowers
Polly sniffs the flowers with a dreamy smile as a small heart floats up beside them

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the wall band (y 0.02-0.18) scale 1.0002, 0 px, cc 1.000 at every step f75-195. Ends at f117, where the window sky starts to darken (time-lapse, next span). Only the vase is in view f67-71; Polly's foot enters at f72. No overlay in top third or bottom fifth

spans.view: with a vase of pale fading flowers on a small round table in front of a round window looking out on a dim snowy hill

beats.text: Polly, holding a whisk at her side, steps up to the vase and reaches a flipper toward the flowers
Polly closes her eyes and sniffs the flowers with a soft smile while petals drop onto the table
Polly keeps sniffing the flowers as a small red heart floats up above her head

beats.text: Polly sits on a wooden chair at the round table, holding up a red book and looking ahead
Polly lays the book down flat on the table, a red heart on its cover
Polly rests her flippers on the book and smiles with her eyes closed

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the table-pedestal band (y 0.72-0.95, x 0.45-1.0) scale 1.0000, <0.5 px, cc 1.000 f247-267; compare 243/269 table and chair edges overlap. The cover's lettering is too small to read here (the next shot shows it). No overlay in top third or bottom fifth
